words.example: The mock survey will spend a morning on the surgical ward.
words.exampleZh: 模拟评审会在外科病区待一个上午。

words.example: Our scorecard improved after we shortened the registration queue.
words.exampleZh: 挂号排队缩短之后，计分卡有了改善。

words.example: Monday's dashboard review will focus on waiting time.
words.exampleZh: 周一的看板回顾会聚焦等候时间。

words.example: Our target for answering the main phone is three rings.
words.exampleZh: 总机电话的目标是三声之内接起。

words.example: Use last January as the baseline when you describe waiting times.
words.exampleZh: 描述等候时间时，请用去年一月作为基线。

words.meaning: 平均修复时间（Mean Time To Repair）
words.example: MTTR (Mean Time To Repair) for pharmacy outages improved after the new cluster.
words.exampleZh: 新集群上线之后，药房停机的MTTR（平均修复时间）有所改善。

words.meaning: 平均无故障时间（Mean Time Between Failures）
words.example: MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) for these label printers is shorter than the vendor claimed.
words.exampleZh: 这些标签打印机的MTBF（平均无故障时间）比厂商声称的更短。

words.example: Service availability for orders stayed above target despite the noon spike.
words.exampleZh: 尽管午间有一波冲高，医嘱的服务可用性仍然高于目标。

words.example: The error log shows the order service throwing empty values since midnight.
words.exampleZh: 错误日志显示，医嘱服务从午夜起就在抛出空值。

words.example: The event log on this PC records a driver crash every few hours.
words.exampleZh: 这台电脑的事件日志每隔几个小时就记一次驱动程序崩溃。
